Native multiplatform aesthetic profiling tool combining pairwise choice tournament design, Bradley-Terry model estimation, and Kendall transitivity validation.

In each match, select the architectural design that appeals to you most. The tournament uses a mathematical 1-factorization schedule so that every exemplar is shown evenly with maximum spacing between appearances.

Full Mode (45 matches): Complete pairwise comparison across all 10 styles for maximum statistical confidence and Kendall transitivity analysis.\n\nQuick Mode (15 matches): Efficient 3-regular graph subset for rapid aesthetic discovery.

Press [1] or [Left Arrow] for Option A
Press [2] or [Right Arrow] for Option B
Press [U] to Undo, [R] to Redo
Press [Esc] to exit.
Your confidence percentage measures how coherent, decisive, and distinct your aesthetic preferences are:
Decision Consistency (\u03B6): Measures transitivity. 100% means you never made circular contradictory choices (such as A > B, B > C, but C > A).
Victory Margin (\u0394): The probability lead separating your #1 champion style from the runner-up.
Contradictions (Triads): The exact count of cyclic preference loops detected.
Confidence Formula: (0.45\u03B6 + 0.35 f(\u0394) + 0.20 C_H) \u00D7 100% synthesizes transitivity, victory margin, and entropy concentration.
